Carbon Energy | 💭 Perspective | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This Perspective highlights iSCAT as a transformative, lab-accessible operando technique for nanoscale visualization of lithiation dynamics and SOC heterogeneity in lithium-ion battery electrodes. It uniquely links microscopic particle-level insights—crystallographic orientation, architecture, kinetics—to rational design strategies like graded and low-tortuosity electrodes, and proposes integrating iSCAT with multimodal characterization and machine learning to accelerate development of high-performance, durable energy storage.

item.title: Nano‐Crosslinked Polyether‐Based Gel Polymer Electrolytes for Interface‐Stable High‐Voltage Lithium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت ژل پلیمری نانو-شبکه‌ای بر پایه PEG و LAP با تنظیم سولواتاسیون، فصل مشترک پایدار و چرخه‌پذیری فوق‌العاده طولانی در باتری‌های لیتیوم-یون ولتاژ بالا ایجاد می‌کند.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Nano-crosslinked gel polymer electrolyte via PEG triethoxysilylation and laponite coupling creates a 3D network with continuous Li⁺ pathways. Laponite anchors solvent molecules, weakening Li⁺-solvent coordination and enabling anion-rich solvation for LiF-rich interphases. This suppresses interfacial side reactions, yielding 6600 h symmetric cycling, 1300 cycles LiFePO₄/Li, and 450 cycles high-voltage NCM/Li.
🏷 gel polymer electrolyte · nano-crosslinked polyether · laponite nanosheets · high-voltage lithium-ion battery · solvation regulation

item.title: Bulk/Surface Coengineering in Layered Oxides via Selective Niobium Doping to Enable Durable High‐Energy Sodium‐Ion Pouch Cells
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Selective Nb doping in layered Na-ion cathodes drives Nb to P2 surface interstitial sites, boosting P2 fraction from 25% to 54% and forming a protective layer against transition-metal dissolution. Combined with bulk Li/Zn co-doping, this enables 600-cycle stability at 4.3 V, 154 Wh kg⁻¹ Ah-level pouch cells, reduced gassing, and nail-penetration safety—advancing durable, high-voltage sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · layered oxide cathode · niobium doping · high-voltage cycling · pouch cell

item.title: Decoupling Quasi‐Solid‐State Sulfur Conversion Mechanisms in Weakly Solvating and Locally High Concentration Electrolytes
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study decouples quasi-solid-state sulfur conversion by comparing weakly solvating CME–TTE with locally high-concentration G2–TTE electrolytes. It links coordination connectivity, anion participation, and ion transport to electrochemical behavior, showing G2–TTE enables superior interfacial conversion, >900 mAh g⁻¹ over 200 cycles, and a lean-electrolyte pouch cell. These findings establish coupled coordination–transport design principles for practical Li–S batteries.
🏷 Li-S batteries · weakly solvating electrolyte · localized high-concentration electrolyte · polysulfide conversion · solvation structure

item.title: Anion Engineering of Sulfide Solid Electrolytes: From Fundamentals to High‐Performance All‐Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:
مرور جامع مهندسی آنیونی الکترولیت‌های جامد سولفیدی، نقش زیرشبکه آنیونی در رسانش یون لیتیم و راهبردهای جانشینی و اصلاح آنیون برای باتری‌های تمام‌جامد کارآمد.
Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely consolidates anion engineering strategies for sulfide solid electrolytes, linking anionic sublattice design to ionic transport, stability, and interfacial behavior. Its significance lies in systematically bridging fundamental conduction mechanisms with practical battery performance, offering a roadmap for scalable, high-performance all-solid-state batteries.
🏷 sulfide solid electrolytes · anion engineering · all-solid-state batteries · lithium-ion conduction · interfacial compatibility
